data.one_liner: Renders Contentful Rich Text JSON into a Flutter widget tree.
data.what_it_does: Parses the JSON structure returned by Contentful's Rich Text field and builds corresponding Flutter widgets. Supports basic blocks, inline marks, hyperlinks, and allows custom renderers for nodes and marks.
use_when: You need to display Contentful Rich Text content in a Flutter app without writing your own parser.
You want a plug‑and‑play solution that converts Contentful JSON to widgets.
You need to customize rendering of specific marks or blocks.
avoid_when: You require full support for all Contentful node types (e.g., embedded assets, quotes).
You need a highly optimized, hand‑crafted rendering pipeline.
strengths: Easy integration with a single widget call
Supports common blocks and inline styles
Customizable renderers for marks and nodes
weaknesses: Limited node support; some Contentful features not implemented
Customization requires understanding of provided render APIs
